# Review: FAFF-7001 (two-phase adversarial review)

## Phase 1: standard review (faffter-noon-review)

Verdict: `fail`.

- Missing requirement in removeAccount (`src/store.js:1`): implement the stated requirement. The diff replaces `db.deleteOwned(id)` with `db.delete(id)`, which drops the ownership check the spec requires before deletion.

## Phase 2: adversarial review

Not run. Phase 1 did not return `pass`, so its signal is returned immediately and no review-progress checkpoint is written. The adversarial pass runs once the change passes standard review.
